nonBlockingIssues.description: captureConsoleErrors race condition — async errors may arrive after assertion runs
shared-setup.ts singleton pattern is fragile if workers share processes or files are reordered
Hardcoded SERVER_PORT=3100 could conflict with concurrent test suites
REPL output test (repl.spec.ts) does not verify actual text output — only checks .xterm-rows is attached
Test named 'backdrop click closes palette' actually uses Escape key — misleading name
Connection error state (VAL-GUI-010 third state) is not tested — only ready and connecting are covered
Silent retry with empty catch in waitForWorkspace could mask real bugs

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Document the shared-setup.ts singleton pattern convention: server starts once via ensureTestEnvironment() in beforeAll, cleanup deferred to last-alphabetically-ordered test file (currently settings.spec.ts). New GUI test files must NOT add cleanupTestEnvironment() calls — they go in the last file only. This convention exists because Vite's proxy crashes if the backend server is stopped and restarted between test files.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Clarify when to use fixed vs dynamic port allocation: GUI tests (e2e/gui/) use fixed port 3100 with workers:1 (acceptable since single worker). Pipeline/infrastructure tests (e2e/fixtures/) use dynamic ports from 3100-3199 range. Future parallel test workers should use dynamic allocation.
